data.name: Imman
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Imman means 'God is with us'. This name was given to several figures in the Bible, including Immanu'el, who was a prophesied savior, and the high priest Immanu-El in the Second Temple period. For Christians, Imman represents the divine presence of God in our lives and the assurance of His love and guidance.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the presence of God in our lives.
data.numerology_meaning: Indicates independence and leadership. Persons with life path number 1 are born to be leaders, they are self-confident, ambitious, and they have a strong will.

in_hebrew.name: עימן
in_hebrew.meaning: עימן הוא שם שפירושו 'אלוהים עמנו' או 'אלוהים עם נא'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עימן הוא שם עברי שמקורו מהמילה 'עמנו אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים עמנו'. זהו שם שמתייחס לנוכחותו של אלוהים בחייו של האדם. השם מופיע בתנ'ך בספר ישעיהו (ישעיהו 7:14, 8:8) ככינוי לאלוהים. השם עימן הוא גם קיצור של השם 'עמmanuel' שפירושו 'אלוהים עמנו'.

in_greek.name: Ἰμμαν
in_greek.meaning: Ἰμμαν σημαίνει 'Θεός μεθ' ἡμῶν' ἤ 'Θεός παρ' ἡμῖν'
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἰμμαν εἶναι ὄνομα Ἑβραϊκὸν προέλευσις ἀπὸ τὸ 'עמנו אל' ποῦ σημαίνει 'Θεός μεθ' ἡμῶν'. Εἶναι ὄνομα ἀναφορικὸν εἰς τὴν παρουσίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν τῇ ζωῇ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου. Τὸ ὄνομα Ἰμμαν ἀπεφάνη εἰς τὴν Καινή Διαθήκη εἰς τὸ βιβλίον τοῦ Ἠσαΐα (Ἠσαΐας 7:14, 8:8) ὡς ὄνομα Θεοῦ.

in_latin.name: Imman
in_latin.meaning: Imman significat 'Deus nobiscum' vel 'Deus cum nobis'
in_latin.long_meaning: Imman est nomen hebraicum quod originem habet a voce 'עמנו אל' quae significat 'Deus nobiscum'. Est nomen referens ad praesentiam Dei in vita hominis. Nomen Imman apparet in Biblia in libro Isaiae (Isaia 7:14, 8:8) ut nomen Dei.

in_english.name: Imman
in_english.meaning: Imman means 'God is with us' or 'God with us'
in_english.long_meaning: Imman is a Hebrew name originating from the word 'עמנו אל' meaning 'God is with us'. It refers to the presence of God in one's life. The name appears in the Bible in the book of Isaiah (Isaiah 7:14, 8:8) as a name for God. Imman is also a short form of the name 'Emmanuel' which means 'God with us'. The name Imman symbolizes spiritual connection, divine guidance, and reassurance of God's presence.

biblical_reference.note: The name Imman appears in the Bible as a name for God, emphasizing His presence with humanity.
